function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content: At a pressure of about 10 kPa (≈ 0.1 atm) the melting/freezing point of ice is lowered relative to the standard 0 °C at 1 atm.  For pure water the phase‑diagram shows that the freezing point is roughly **–2 °C** at 10 kPa.  This is an approximate value; the exact point can be read from a detailed ice–water phase diagram or calculated with a thermodynamic model that includes the solid phase.
